newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish December jobless rise seen seasonal.
newsitem.headline: Polish December jobless rise seen seasonal.

text.p: The rise in Polish unemployment in December from November was due largely to a fall in seasonal work, senior labour ministry officials said on Thursday.

"The unemployment level rose mainly because a significant number of people are returning from seasonal labour, mainly in construction," Andrzej Pilat, head of the national labour office, told a news conference.
Labour Minister Tadeusz Zelinski said a December fall in employment in rural areas was also seasonal.
Unemployment rose to 13.6 in December from 13.3 in November, but was 14.9 percent in December 1995.
Pilat said joblessness would likely level out in January and February before falling in March.
